-118.47200,34.03570.name: Santa Monica Fertility
-118.47200,34.03570.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Guy E. Ringler, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

21.26872,48.74306.name: Genetická ambulancia
21.26872,48.74306.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

10.98574,45.44250.name: Aptuit (Verona) Srl, an Evotec Company
10.98574,45.44250.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Evotec SE. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-3.99959,55.86588.name: Lanarkshire Acute Hospital NHS Trust
-3.99959,55.86588.state: Infertility Department, Monklands Hospital, Monkscourt Avenue, Airdrie, Lanarkshire, ML6 0JS, United Kingdom
-3.99959,55.86588.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-123.12656,49.24581.name: Children’s Hospital Research Institute of Manitoba
-123.12656,49.24581.status: Certificate of GAP Last visit: interim, October 2022
-123.12656,49.24581.desc: An institution certified by the Canadian Council on Animal Care for its use of animals in science. Certificate of GAP Last visit: interim, October 2022. CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

-83.02064,39.98973.name: Battelle Biomedical Research Center (BRC)
-83.02064,39.98973.state: 505 King Ave, Columbus, OH 43201, United States, United States
-83.02064,39.98973.desc: A BSL3+ laboratory, operational. Run by Battelle. It is categorised as a private laboratory, working on both human and animal health. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

116.29000,40.09000.name: Dabeinong Biotechnology
116.29000,40.09000.desc: A Chinese agricultural biotechnology company holding domestic approvals for engineered maize and soy traits, positioned for the country’s shift from importing engineered feed to growing it. Chinese trait developers are approaching the position the four majors hold elsewhere, with the state as a deliberate partner rather than an arms-length regulator.

79.86120,6.92710.name: Sri Lanka — food labelling and import control
79.86120,6.92710.desc: Sri Lanka requires labelling of engineered foods and controls imports, in a country whose 2021 overnight ban on synthetic fertiliser produced a documented agricultural collapse. That episode is the strongest available caution about changing an agricultural system faster than it can adapt.
